items.title: Polish commander reportedly says weather prevented interception of Russian missile
items.summary: A Russian Kh-101 cruise missile reportedly entered Polish airspace on November 20, but a Swedish Gripen fighter could not intercept it because of severe weather. Polish General Ireneusz Nowak was cited as saying the pilot could not identify the missile visually or through onboard instruments.

items.title: Russian military report claims advances near Vovchansk and Mykolaipillia
items.summary: A Russian frontline report claims its troops expanded positions southwest of Vovchansk in Kharkiv region and reached the southern outskirts of Mykolaipillia on the Kostiantynivka axis. It also describes continuing clashes around Kupiansk, Dobropillia and the Zaporizhzhia front, without asserting a wider breakthrough.
